{{Quote|Nerra, Nerra!|Numa, saying "brother" to Waxer and Boil|<ref name="Innocents" />}}
'''Numa''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded Ryloth, during which Numa's parents were presumed killed. While most of the surviving Twi'leks in Nabat were rounded up and taken as prisoners, Numa was able to avoid capture, and lived in the abandoned city and the tunnel system underneath it during the Separatist occupation. Later, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched a counterattack to free Ryloth and its people. During the subsequent [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|battle]], Numa befriended a pair of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] named [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]], who had been on a reconnaissance to Nabat. After the trio escaped from a group of [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]]&mdash;which had been released by the Separatist's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] to halt the Republic's advance&mdash;through the underground tunnels, they met back up with Waxer and Boil's [[Ghost Company/Legends|squad]]. Numa showed the company's commander, [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the system of tunnels she had been hiding in, which they used to flank the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces controlling Nabat and free the captured Twi'leks. During the battle, Numa was reunited with her uncle, [[Nilim Bril/Legends|Nilim Bril]].

==Biography==

===Early Life===
Numa was a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]]<ref name="Innocents" /> born around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="IOR Guide" /> She lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] with [[Numa's father/Legends|her]] [[Numa's mother/Legends|parents]]<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="IOR Guide" /> She had an uncle named [[Nilim Bril/Legends|Nilim Bril]].<ref name="EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> At a young age she used to play in the tunnel system underneath Nabat.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" />

===The Clone Wars===

====Losing her family====
[[File:NumasFamily-Curfew.png|thumb|250x250px|Numa alongside her parents.]]
One day<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref>[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 82|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 82]] {{C|22 BBY 93-96: Deadly Dangers}} dates the events of "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]" to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. [[The Clone Wars: Curfew|''The Clone Wars: C''urfew]] takes places shortòy before the episode.</ref> Numa was playing with her friend [[Lubo (Twi'lek)|Lubo]] in Nabat's market place while her [[Numa's mother/Legends|mother]] was shopping, when [[Tronda]], a friend of her mother, said that she sensed a storm coming, even though the skies were clear. When Numa and her mother returned home, [[Numa's father/Legends|Numa's father]] asked her why he had found her [[Tooka doll/Legends|tooka doll]] in the tunnel system underneath Nabat, which the Twi'lek's used as shelter during storms. Numa said that tooka had followed a "bright eye" down into the tunnels last night.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" />

Later that night, Numa again saw the "bright eye"&mdash;which actually was a [[Separatist probe droid/Legends|Separatist recon droid]]&mdash;and began to follow it. As Numa followed the recon droid into the tunnels system, she heard several loud explosions, scaring the young Twi'lek. Numa climbed out of the tunnels, and saw a large [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] invasion force landing on Ryloth, with the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] already on the ground taking away the surviving Twi'leks.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew">''[[The Clone Wars: Curfew]]''</ref> The Confederacy of Independent Systems had invaded Ryloth and enslaved most of its Twi'lek populace. The Republic soon mounted a bold offensive to invade and [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]] the planet.<ref name="Innocents" /> Both Numa's father and mother had [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the raid, orphaning the young Twi'lek.<ref name="DB-Numa">{{DB|character|numa|Numa}}</ref> She escaped being captured by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist droid army]] by hiding in the tunnels.<ref name=":0">{{SWE|characters|numa|Numa}}</ref>

====The Battle of Ryloth====
[[File:Numa_leads_Waxer_and_Boil.png|thumb|left|250x250px|Numa leads Waxer and Boil through Nabat]]

Numa continued to lived in the abandoned city and its tunnel system.<ref name=":0" /> In the earliest stage of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], while scouting ahead, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] of [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]] met Numa in an alley. Initially thinking them to be enemy droids, Numa was rather fearful of them, even going so far as to bite Boil's finger. However, after the two took off their helmets, she relaxed, even calling the two "Nerra!", and she accepted a [[Ration bar/Legends|ration bar]] from the clones. Boil was initially against helping her, but Waxer, who was compassionate for the girl, worried about her well-being. Numa led the clones to her home, which was now wrecked and practically empty. After Waxer gave her a [[Tooka doll/Legends|tooka doll]], she began to cry, and the two clones comforted her. However, after Waxer and Boil received a transmission from [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], they realized that they were late and had disobeyed orders.<ref name="Innocents" />

[[File:Waxer_and_Boil_comfort_Numa.png|thumb|250x250px|[[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] comfort Numa]]

As the two clones began to leave, a group of [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]] appeared, and they were forced back into the house. Numa showed the two clones an underground passage beneath a carpet in her house, and they entered it, eventually re-emerging near Obi-Wan, Cody and Ghost Company, who had just encountered the gutkurrs themselves. Cody was initially displeased with the clones, but once Obi-Wan saw Numa, he understood what had "sidetracked" the two. Obi-Wan conversed to Numa in Twi'leki, and learned that she could take them to the prisoners via the tunnels. Cody created a diversion, and Obi-Wan was able to free the Twi'lek prisoners, and Numa was reunited with her uncle, [[Nilim Bril/Legends|Nilim Bril]].<ref name="Innocents" />

[[File:TX-20_targets_Obi-Wan_and_Numa.png|thumb|left|250x250px|[[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]] targets Obi-Wan and Numa]]

After Obi-Wan, Waxer and Boil destroyed the [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannons]], [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]] appeared in his [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tank]] and blasted the three aside. Numa, fearing for her friends, ran over to Waxer and Boil, demonstating her bravery and compassion for her friends. Once they had recovered, she returned to Obi-Wan. TX-20 targeted the two, but before he could destroy them, the Twi'leks, inspired by her courage, attacked the tactical droid and forcefully dismantled him, while Obi-Wan attempted, unsuccessfully, to shield her eyes from the violence.<ref name="Innocents" />

As the Republic forces prepared to march to the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] and retake it to free the planet, Waxer and Boil said goodbye to her, promising that they would be back. Numa called out "Nerra!" one last time, and Obi-Wan translated its meaning: ''brother''.<ref name="Innocents" />

===Legacy===
After their encounter on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] <ref name="Innocents" /> [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] and [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] added cartoon drawings of Numa on their helmets<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" /><ref name="Darkness on Umbara" /> to honor her.<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|boil|Boil}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Numa-SWE.png|thumb|right|180px|Numa]]
Numa was only a child during the Clone Wars, therefore she was wary and scared of droids and other threats. However, Numa was not afraid to defend herself, as seen when she bit Boil's finger. She was nonetheless very brave and cared for her friends.<ref name="Innocents" /> A resourceful girl,<ref name=":1" /> Numa helped to nurture compassion in both Waxer and Boil, and the two clones cared for her to the extent of delaying their mission to help the young girl.<ref name="Innocents" />

==Behind the scenes==
Numa is portrayed by voice actress [[Catherine Taber]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]].<ref name="Innocents" /> In a tweet, Taber opined that, in her mind, Numa was descended from the characters [[Mission Vao]] and [[Vette]], whom she also voiced.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|cattaber|status/790741579224887296|[[Catherine Taber]]|quote=I believe Vette, Mission & Numa from #CloneWars & #StarWarsRebels are all related (they DO have similar voices(; ) #StarWars #Twileks #SWTOR|archivefile=File:Catherine Taber-Numa Tweet.png}}</ref>

While her character did not appeared in any other episodes of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']], a cartoon drawing of Numa appears on the right side of Boil's helmet in the episode "[[Landing at Point Rain]]",<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> and on Waxer's helmet in "[[Darkness on Umbara]]" and "[[Carnage of Krell]]".<ref name="Darkness on Umbara">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref><ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

An older [[Numa]] has since appeared in the [[Canon]] series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', expanding her story, in which she fought for the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. While the show itself is part of the [[Canon]] cotinuity, it is unknown what became of Numa in the Legends continuity.<ref name="Homecoming">{{Rebels|Homecoming}}</ref>
